cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Bearer of Grudges
cards.gameText: Damage +1. While Gimli is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats. While Gimli is damage +X, he is resistance +X.

cards.title: Galadriel
cards.subtitle: Bearer of Wisdom
cards.gameText: While Galadriel bears an artifact or The One Ring, she is resistance +1 for each [ELVEN] companion you can spot.
cards.lore: “‘...I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night!...Dreadful as the Storm and the Lightning!'”

cards.title: Glorfindel
cards.subtitle: Revealed in Wrath
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may exert Glorfindel to make a Nazgul he is skirmishing strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

cards.title: Radagast
cards.subtitle: The Brown
cards.gameText: The move limit is +1. When Radagast leaves play, this bonus is immediately lost. Each time the fellowship moves, each opponent may discard 2 cards from hand to draw 2 cards.
cards.lore: “‘...a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts....'”

cards.title: Sent Back
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard each minion skirmishing your Wizard. Place that Wizard in your dead pile. Fellowship: Play a Wizard (even if another copy of that Wizard is in your dead pile).

cards.title: Smeagol
cards.subtitle: Bearer of Great Secrets
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time the fellowship moves, place an unbound companion in the dead pile. Regroup: If Smeagol is the Ring-bearer, add 2 burdens to discard each minion.
cards.lore: “‘...he used it to find out secrets, and he put his knowledge to crooked and malicious uses.'”

cards.title: Boromir
cards.subtitle: Bearer of Council
cards.gameText: While Boromir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or wound him twice. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, discard each minion he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “‘True-hearted Men, they will not be corrupted. We of Minas Tirith have been staunch....’”

cards.title: Elendil
cards.subtitle: The Tall
cards.gameText: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Regroup: Discard a [GONDOR] artifact borne by a companion to liberate a site.
cards.lore: “...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....”

cards.title: Isildur
cards.subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms
cards.gameText: While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions. While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [GONDOR] knight is strength +1.
cards.lore: “‘“But for my part I will risk no hurt to this thing: of all the works of Sauron the only fair.”'”

cards.title: Sapling of the White Tree
cards.gameText: To play, spot an unbound [GONDOR] Man. Response: If a [GONDOR] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that wound and heal that Man.
cards.lore: “‘Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of Trees.'”

cards.title: The Red Arrow
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Discard this and exert a Man to take a Free Peoples Man of a different culture into hand from your draw deck. Regroup: Exert 2 of your Men to discard a Man from your dead pile. Remove this artifact from the game.
cards.lore: “‘The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'”

cards.title: Bilbo
cards.subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3). Regroup: Add a burden to play a [SHIRE] tale.
cards.lore: “‘But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'”
